name: run-postmortem
description: The run-diagnostician, productised (D7): a deterministic facts collector over a FOREIGN run dir (statuses, attempts, errors, invalidation reasons, verdicts, and the journal's verify-trace outcome) -> a readonly analyst writes POSTMORTEM.md in which every claim cites a run-dir artifact as [artifact: <relpath>] -> a deterministic citation gate: every cited path must exist (heals the analyst once). Each expensive failure becomes a durable, evidence-checked document instead of a chat transcript. Reads the target run dir only; never resumes or edits it.
